words.definition: happening once every year
words.example: Our school holds an annual sports day every June.
words.cloze: Our school holds an ________ sports day every June.

words.definition: important and in need of immediate attention
words.example: The doctor received an urgent call and left immediately.
words.cloze: The doctor received an ________ call and left immediately.

words.definition: to make an arrangement with someone, often by phone or writing
words.example: Please confirm your booking by email before Friday.
words.cloze: Please ________ your booking by email before Friday.

words.definition: visiting interesting places when on holiday
words.example: We spent the afternoon sightseeing in London.
words.cloze: We spent the afternoon ________ in London.

words.definition: the main subject/topic of a competition, book etc.
words.example: The theme of this year's writing competition is friendship.
words.cloze: The ________ of this year's writing competition is friendship.

words.definition: someone who can imagine how something could be made and then draw a plan for it
words.example: The designer drew a plan for our new kitchen.
words.cloze: The ________ drew a plan for our new kitchen.

words.definition: conversations, that might be not true, about other people's lives
words.example: Don't believe all the gossip you hear about other people.
words.cloze: Don't believe all the ________ you hear about other people.

words.definition: television programmes about ordinary people, who are filmed in real-life situations
words.example: My sister enjoys watching reality TV about ordinary families.
words.cloze: My sister enjoys watching ________ about ordinary families.

words.definition: a story/film, etc. that describes a situation that is very different from real life
words.example: The film is a fantasy about a boy who can speak to dragons.
words.cloze: The film is a ________ about a boy who can speak to dragons.

words.definition: to direct advertising of a product at a specific group of people
words.example: These advertisements target teenagers who enjoy online games.
words.cloze: These advertisements ________ teenagers who enjoy online games.

words.definition: with the latest information
words.example: The website gives up-to-date information about train times.
words.cloze: The website gives ________ information about train times.

words.definition: being the only one of your type
words.example: Every snowflake has a unique shape.
words.cloze: Every snowflake has a ________ shape.

words.definition: very good or excellent at something
words.example: We had a fabulous time at the concert.
words.cloze: We had a ________ time at the concert.

words.definition: to include something as a part
words.example: These biscuits contain nuts, so check the label carefully.
words.cloze: These biscuits ________ nuts, so check the label carefully.

words.definition: a piece of writing in a magazine/newspaper/blog/website, that is always written by the same person and has a particular subject
words.example: She writes a weekly column about gardening for the newspaper.
words.cloze: She writes a weekly ________ about gardening for the newspaper.

words.definition: someone's bad behaviour that intentionally hurts or frightens other people
words.example: Our school takes bullying seriously and helps students feel safe.
words.cloze: Our school takes ________ seriously and helps students feel safe.

words.definition: a type of story/book written about not real events and characters
words.example: I prefer reading fiction because I enjoy imaginary stories.
words.cloze: I prefer reading ________ because I enjoy imaginary stories.

words.definition: a person who has a great interest in a particular subject
words.example: As a cycling enthusiast, Ben spends every weekend on his bike.
words.cloze: As a cycling ________, Ben spends every weekend on his bike.

words.definition: something that is making you feel you want to do something
words.example: The athlete gave an inspiring talk about never giving up.
words.cloze: The athlete gave an ________ talk about never giving up.

words.definition: when your actions or behaviour is brave
words.example: The firefighter received a medal for her bravery.
words.cloze: The firefighter received a medal for her ________.

words.definition: having good judgment and the ability to act correctly and make decisions on your own
words.example: Please use the school computers responsibly and follow the rules.
words.cloze: Please use the school computers ________ and follow the rules.

words.definition: the level of quality of something
words.example: The food at this restaurant is of a very high standard.
words.cloze: The food at this restaurant is of a very high ________.

words.definition: when a person, organisation, etc. is continuing to live or exist
words.example: Clean drinking water is essential for human survival.
words.cloze: Clean drinking water is essential for human ________.

words.definition: to refuse to allow something (especially officially)
words.example: The council plans to ban cars from the town centre.
words.cloze: The council plans to ________ cars from the town centre.

words.definition: a place where teenagers can go to meet with other teenagers, play sports and do different social activities
words.example: We meet our friends at the youth club after school.
words.cloze: We meet our friends at the ________ after school.

words.definition: when something started not long ago
words.example: I have recently started learning to play the guitar.
words.cloze: I have ________ started learning to play the guitar.

words.definition: staying in the same condition for ever
words.example: The old swimming pool has closed permanently and will not reopen.
words.cloze: The old swimming pool has closed ________ and will not reopen.

words.definition: to join together, to put things, ideas, etc. together
words.example: You can combine exercise with fun by joining a dance class.

words.definition: something limited only for a few people, or one person
words.example: Only members can enter this exclusive club.
words.cloze: Only members can enter this ________ club.

words.definition: the people working together, on an aircraft, ship etc.
words.example: The ship's crew prepared for the long journey across the ocean.
words.cloze: The ship's ________ prepared for the long journey across the ocean.

words.definition: someone who is walking in an area where vehicles pass
words.example: The driver stopped to let a pedestrian cross the road.
words.cloze: The driver stopped to let a ________ cross the road.

words.definition: to remain permanently in a particular place
words.example: After travelling for years, they decided to settle in a small village.
words.cloze: After travelling for years, they decided to ________ in a small village.
